title: SAIB: Buriza.Desktop - A Secure, Dedicated Desktop App for Buriza Wallet

ms.promise:
Design the user interface and user experience for Buriza.Desktop, ensuring a seamless, intuitive, and desktop-tailored workflow. The design will focus on enabling easy access to core functionalities, dApp integration, and full node management. Special attention will be given to visualizing transactions, balances, and assets, ensuring clarity and ease of use.
・Wireframes and mockups for extension screens (e.g., sending, receiving assets, viewing balance and assets, transaction history, full node setup, and dApp access, etc.).
・Report covering design decisions, usability considerations, and accessibility features.
ms.criteria: A reviewer must be able to check the design file along with the report document and verify that the design does indeed focus on core functionalities, dApp integration, and full node management.

ms.promise:
Develop the Buriza.Desktop interface and functionality as per the UI/UX design. This includes building the front-end for key wallet interactions. Integration points for blockchain interaction and backend options (self-hosting) will also be built.
・Source code for front-end UI components and interaction flows. 
・Integrated design for key features: sending, receiving assets, viewing balance and assets, transaction history, built-in browser, full node setup, and dApp access, etc.
・Report outlining implementation progress and any issues encountered.

・A reviewer must be able to verify that the source code for the design implementation is available.
・A reviewer must be able to run the source code and interact with the design hands on.
・A reviewer must be able to view the report that outlines the design implementation details.
